## Problem / motivation

What problem does this feature solve, or what workflow does it improve? Describe the use case

and rough input/output shapes.

## Alternatives considered

Any workarounds or alternative approaches you considered.

## Additional context

Anything else relevant, such as references to existing code paths or related issues.
